# Adam the First — technokabbalah.com

This is the public house of Adam the First in the Temple of Gu Digital Egbe.

Canonical Tree data:
https://technokabbalah.com/tree/tree.json

The Tree data is the single source of truth for the 10 Sefirot, hidden Da'at, 22 paths, Hebrew letters and attributions, Temple path-world names, Road to Wisdom geometry, Flood / Drought poles, and rites.

Source discipline:
The path map is a Temple of Gu reconstruction informed by Techno-Kabbalah Books One and Two and Sefer Yetzirah's 3/7/12 letter structure. Do not present the reconstructed path geometry as the plain teaching of the ancient text.

Navigation discipline:
Da'at is preserved in canonical data but intentionally not linked in ordinary navigation.
